answer: An applicant locks 35 POA for 22 epochs and completes 8 sequential trials derived from a delayed jetty beacon before receiving a nontransferable lease. Correlations are recorded in a mesa Merkle cluster; the nth linked identity doubles its bond, so k sybils immobilize 35(2^k-1) POA. Validators compare fingerprints across 12 epochs and bind the cluster proof to a horizon receipt; payouts require 5 of 7 signatures.
